variant.description: With variant: the values matched, as the filter was read.

counts.description: With counts: the instances found, by component and variant, in the order first met. A variant no instance uses is not listed.

component.description: The component set's name, or a component's without variants.

variant.description: The variant as Figma names it.

countsCut.description: The time ran out before every layer was counted: counts cover the layers reached. Search within less.

side.description: Where it sits from the screen; over it when their boxes overlap.

distance.description: The gap between its box and the screen's, in px.

on.description: The variant of a set the link is on.

property.description: Where the layer uses it: fill, stroke, effect, text, a text run, or a field.
